features.name: normalized_credit_amount
features.description: Min-max normalized credit amount to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents the large scale of credit_amount from dominating the Euclidean distance metric in KNN.

features.name: normalized_duration
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the duration feature to a [0, 1] scale, improving neighborhood geometry.

features.name: normalized_age
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the age feature to a [0, 1] scale, ensuring it contributes proportionally to distance metrics.

features.name: amount_per_duration_scaled
features.description: Monthly payment proxy (amount divided by duration), scaled and clipped to [0, 1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the intensity of the loan repayment schedule, normalized for distance-based models.

features.name: financial_commitment_index
features.description: Combined index of installment commitment and existing credits, normalized to [0, 1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple ordinal commitment features into a single continuous dimension for smoother distance calculations.

features.name: age_duration_interaction
features.description: Ratio of age to loan duration, scaled and clipped.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights applicants taking loans that span a significant portion of their age, providing a normalized geometric feature.

features.name: has_valuable_property_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for owning real estate or life insurance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a distinct spatial separation in the KNN feature space for applicants with significant collateral.

features.name: distance_to_average_applicant
features.description: Euclidean distance to the mean values of credit_amount, duration, and age (using standardized values).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a radial basis feature measuring how typical or anomalous an applicant's core numeric profile is.

features.name: generic_high_risk_profile_similarity
features.description: Semantic similarity score to a generic high-risk profile (e.g., no checking, low savings, renting, unskilled).
features.expected_model_benefit: Embeds complex categorical combinations into a single continuous similarity metric, ideal for KNN.

features.name: generic_stable_profile_similarity
features.description: Semantic similarity score to a generic stable profile (e.g., high savings, own housing, skilled job, long employment).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous spatial dimension representing overall financial stability based on categorical attributes.

features.name: employment_stability_score
features.description: Semantic score evaluating the stability of employment based on duration and job type.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates ordinal and categorical employment data into a smooth numeric scale for distance computation.

features.name: credit_history_quality_score
features.description: Semantic score evaluating the quality of past credit history and existing credits.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts categorical credit history descriptions into a continuous metric, improving neighborhood resolution.
